title: An illustrative portability decision
method: Synthetic inputs: 80 days/year × 3 = 240; subtract 30 adoption days, then 150 exit days. No discounting or probability weighting; not a customer result.
alt: An illustrative portability decision: Three-year saving 240 engineer-days, After adoption 210 engineer-days, After one exit 60 engineer-days. Illustrative inputs.
